certificate.description: The UD Info DB Series SSD Drives consists of multi-chip embedded cryptographic modules designed to meet FIPS 140-3 Level 2 requirements. These SSDs provide access control and feature built-in AES-XTS-256 encryption hardware for on-the-fly encryption of user data before it is stored on NAND Flash. UD Info SSDs support NVMe PCIe interfaces and they are based on the industry-standard TCG Opal SSC protocol.
